games:2026-wk9-florida-georgia.blurb: The rivalry game brings No. 17 Florida to Jacksonville's other favorite stage against No. 3 Georgia, with the Bulldogs laying 11.5 and a 56.5 total. ESPN gives Georgia an 81.6% shot, but the Gators get a free swing at the SEC's front-runner.

games:2026-wk9-arizona-texas-tech.blurb: No. 22 Arizona at No. 13 Texas Tech is the tightest ranked matchup on the board, with the Red Raiders favored by just 3.5 and ESPN giving them a 66.5% edge. A loss here would sting for a Texas Tech team already sitting outside the playoff field.

games:2026-wk9-auburn-ole-miss.blurb: No. 12 Ole Miss is an 11.5-point home favorite over Auburn with the total at 57.5. The Rebels are first in line on the bubble, so style points matter as much as the win.

games:2026-wk9-utah-cincinnati.blurb: No. 6 Utah goes on the road to Cincinnati as a 7-point favorite, with ESPN pegging the Utes at 70.8%. Utah leads the Big 12 race and can't afford a slip against an unranked host.

games:2026-wk9-virginia-wake-forest.blurb: No. 14 Wake Forest hosts Virginia as a 12.5-point favorite in a game with a modest 48.5 total. The Demon Deacons are trending up on the bubble and need to take care of business.

games:2026-wk9-mississippi-state-texas.blurb: No. 11 Texas is a 20.5-point home favorite over Mississippi State and a 90.1% pick per ESPN. The Longhorns jumped eight spots in the poll this week and this is a chance to keep the climb going.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk9-smu-syracuse.blurb: No. 19 SMU heads to Syracuse favored by 10.5 with a 58.5 total, the highest number on the early slate. ESPN gives the Mustangs a 72% chance to handle it.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk9-notre-dame-navy.blurb: No. 5 Notre Dame meets Navy in the long-running rivalry as a 30.5-point favorite, with ESPN giving the Irish a 98.7% win probability. Anything other than a comfortable afternoon would be a genuine shock.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk9-minnesota-india.blurb: No. 4 Indiana hosts Minnesota as a 20.5-point favorite with the total down at 40.5. The Hoosiers sit two spots behind Ohio State in the Big Ten race and can't let one slip.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk9-ohio-state-usc.blurb: No. 2 Ohio State visits USC as a 6.5-point favorite, the Buckeyes' stiffest test of the week with ESPN still giving them an 82.7% edge. A road stumble would crack the Big Ten race wide open.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk9-nevada-ucla.blurb: No. 7 UCLA welcomes Nevada as a 22.5-point favorite and a 93.5% pick. The Bruins moved up to No. 7 this week and this is a tune-up, nothing more.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk9-texas-state-boi.blurb: No. 20 Boise State closes out the night at home against Texas State, favored by 10.5 with a 63.5 total that suggests points. ESPN has the Broncos at 86.2%.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk9-arizona-state-b.blurb: No. 8 BYU hosts Arizona State as a 16.5-point favorite with a 90.4% win probability. The Cougars are chasing Utah in the Big 12 and need every clean week they can get.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk9-wisconsin-iowa.blurb: No. 25 Wisconsin at Iowa is a coin flip with a 36.5 total, the Hawkeyes favored by 2.5 and ESPN giving them 57.3%. Expect field position and field goals to decide it.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk9-miami-north-car.blurb: No. 1 Miami travels to North Carolina as a 14-point favorite and an 89.8% pick. The Hurricanes have the top spot to protect in a night-window road game.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk9-northwestern-or.blurb: No. 21 Northwestern is a 3.5-point underdog at Oregon in one of the tightest lines of the day. ESPN gives the Ducks 70.2% despite the short number, making this a real danger spot for both.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk9-missouri-arkans.blurb: No. 23 Missouri goes to Arkansas as a 10-point road favorite with ESPN at 73.8% for the Tigers. A late SEC kickoff with ranking implications for Mizzou.

rankedNextGames:2026-wk9-oklahoma-state-.blurb: No. 24 Oklahoma State is a 9.5-point favorite at Iowa State in a Big 12 road test with a 57.5 total. ESPN gives the Cowboys a 71.3% shot.

predictions:kentucky.blurb: Kentucky climbed from 12th to 9th and now sits as the SEC's closest chaser behind Georgia, though the computers are cooler on the Wildcats than the poll is (31st in SP+, 24th in FPI).

predictions:texas.blurb: Texas made the week's biggest jump, 19th to 11th, and the metrics back it up completely: eighth in both SP+ and FPI.

predictions:ucla.blurb: UCLA is up to No. 7 in the Big Ten picture, but the models are split on the Bruins -- 17th in SP+, down at 31st in FPI.

predictions:tennessee.blurb: Tennessee slid from 11th to 16th in the poll even as the advanced numbers keep the Vols in the low teens (11th SP+, 12th FPI).

predictions:lsu.blurb: LSU moved up to 15th and the metrics think that's still too low -- third in SP+ and seventh in FPI make the Tigers one of the most underrated teams on the board.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-big-ten.blurb: Ohio State at No. 2 and Indiana at No. 4 are separated by just two spots in the Big Ten's race for the automatic bid, so neither can afford a loose Saturday.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-big-12.blurb: The Big 12's auto bid is a two-team fight right now: Utah at No. 6 with BYU breathing down its neck at No. 8.

fieldStorylines:conf-race-sec.blurb: Georgia at No. 3 has the clearest cushion of any league leader, six spots up on next-closest SEC team Kentucky at No. 9.

bubbleNotes:ole-miss.blurb: Ole Miss is the first team out at the 13 seed, one spot from the field after sliding five places -- the Rebels need to stop the bleeding in a hurry.

bubbleNotes:lsu.blurb: LSU is the last team in the bubble group at 16, four spots from the field, but the Tigers moved up three and are headed the right direction.

bubbleNotes:texas-tech.blurb: Texas Tech dropped five to the 14 seed, two spots shy of the field, and draws No. 22 Arizona next -- a ranked win is exactly the resume piece they need.

bubbleNotes:wake-forest.blurb: Wake Forest climbed three spots to the 15 seed and sits three away from the field, with momentum finally on its side.
